profile.name: Segun Oluyi
profile.summary: I help businesses turn data, research, and business questions into clear insights and practical decisions.

about.heading: About Me
about.summary: I bring together data analytics, business research, and clear communication to help people make practical decisions.
bio_paragraphs: I’m a data and business analyst who brings research, business planning, and clear communication to analytical work. I use data to understand problems, identify opportunities, and turn findings into practical recommendations.

My path began in content and business writing, where I learned to make complex information useful to different audiences. Today, I combine that foundation with dashboards, data analysis, and training content that help people make better-informed decisions.
about.skills_intro: The tools and methods I use to move from a question to a useful answer.
